name: gatelogic
description: Every decision the door gate makes: the wiring table as a compile-time struct, the lock's two polarity questions composed in one place, scanner line assembly, the repeat-scan debounce, the online-first flow and its roster fallback, the release window with its hard cap and its relock dwells, the LED patterns, and the fault aggregator that turns what this board notices about itself into one counted event per code per window. Knows about a door and nothing else, which is why it is not in shared/lib — with one stated exception: FaultLog is gate-local because the court box owns the other copy, and merging them into shared/lib is owed. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for Xtensa and host.
keywords: gate, door, lock, relay, scanner, fault, embedded
